verses.sloka: दृष्ट्वा आश्रम पदम् शून्यम् रामो दशरथ आत्मजः।रहिताम् पर्णशालाम् च प्रविद्धानि आसनानि च ॥३-६१-१॥
verses.transliteration: dṛṣṭvā āśrama padam śūnyam rāmo daśaratha ātmajaḥ।rahitām parṇaśālām ca praviddhāni āsanāni ca ॥3-61-1॥

translations.english: Rama, son of Dasaratha, saw the empty cottage devoid of Sita. The mats were displaced. He searched everywhere but unable to see Vaidehi lifted his lovely arms and said:
translations.hindi: ह अरउपकारड का इकसठवां सरा पूरा हुआ । —$— हिषष्टितमः सर्ग; —& — . सीतामपरयन्‌ धर्मात्मा कामोपहतचेतनः । दिललाप महाबाहू रामः कमललोचनः

verses.sloka: अदृष्ट्वा तत्र वैदेहीम् संनिरीक्ष्य च सर्वशः ।उवाच रामः प्राक्रुश्य प्रगृह्य रुचिरौ भुजौ ॥३-६१-२॥
verses.transliteration: adṛṣṭvā tatra vaidehīm saṁnirīkṣya ca sarvaśaḥ ।uvāca rāmaḥ prākruśya pragṛhya rucirau bhujau ॥3-61-2॥

translations.english: Rama, son of Dasaratha, saw the empty cottage devoid of Sita. The mats were displaced. He searched everywhere but unable to see Vaidehi lifted his lovely arms and said:

verses.sloka: क्व नु लक्ष्मण वैदेही कम् वा देशम् इतो गता ।केन आहृता वा सौमित्रे भक्षिता केन वा प्रिया ॥३-६१-३॥
verses.transliteration: kva nu lakṣmaṇa vaidehī kam vā deśam ito gatā ।kena āhṛtā vā saumitre bhakṣitā kena vā priyā ॥3-61-3॥

translations.english: O son of Sumitra, where is my beloved ? Where did she go? By whom was she abducted? Or, devoured? O Lakshmana
translations.hindi: सीताको न देख कर भी मानों (सीताको) देखते हप श्रीरामचन्द्र काम से पीड़ित हो गद्गद कण्ठ से बोले ॥ दा त्वमशोकस्य शाखाभिः पुष्पमियतया प्रिये । आष्ठणोपि शरीरं ते मम शोकविवधनी

verses.sloka: वृक्षेण आवार्य यदि माम् सीते हसितुम् इच्छसि ।अलम् ते हसितेन अद्य माम् भजस्व सुदुःखितम् ॥३-६१-४॥
verses.transliteration: vṛkṣeṇa āvārya yadi mām sīte hasitum icchasi ।alam te hasitena adya mām bhajasva suduḥkhitam ॥3-61-4॥

translations.english: O Sita if you intend to make fun by hiding behind a tree, I tell you it is enough. Stop it and come to this extremely sorrowful man.

verses.sloka: यैः सह क्रीडसे सीते विश्वस्तैः मृग पोतकैः ।एते हीनाः त्वया सौम्ये ध्यायन्ति अस्र आविल ईक्षणाः ॥३-६१-५॥
verses.transliteration: yaiḥ saha krīḍase sīte viśvastaiḥ mṛga potakaiḥ ।ete hīnāḥ tvayā saumye dhyāyanti asra āvila īkṣaṇāḥ ॥3-61-5॥

translations.english: O gentle Sita those fawns who trusted you and played with you, are now separated from you. Brooding over you, their eyes are brimming with tears.
translations.hindi: हे भद्र ! हे देवि ! तू हसती हुई कर्शिकार के बन में विचर रही है, किन्तु मुझको पीड़ा देकर; अतः अबः मेरे साथ ठट्टा मत कर

verses.sloka: सीताया रहितो अहम् वै न हि जीवामि लक्ष्मण ।वृतम् शोकेन महता सीता हरणजेन माम् ॥३-६१-६॥
verses.transliteration: sītāyā rahito aham vai na hi jīvāmi lakṣmaṇa ।vṛtam śokena mahatā sītā haraṇajena mām ॥3-61-6॥

translations.english: O Lakshmana, I cannot live without Sita. I am filled with deep grief on account of Sita's abduction. My late father, the king will certainly see me in the other world (I will definitely commit suicide).

verses.sloka: पर लोके महाराजो नूनम् द्रक्ष्यति मे पिता ।कथम् प्रतिज्ञाम् संश्रुत्य मया त्वम् अभियोजितः ॥३-६१-७॥
verses.transliteration: para loke mahārājo nūnam drakṣyati me pitā ।katham pratijñām saṁśrutya mayā tvam abhiyojitaḥ ॥3-61-7॥

translations.english: My father say will surely in the other world: Without completing the appointed period of the vow taken, how could you come here ? Fie upon you You are irresponsible. You are ignoble. You are a liar.

verses.sloka: अपूरयित्वा तम् कालम् मत् सकाशम् इह आगतः ।काम वृत्तम् अनार्यम् माम् मृषा वादिनम् एव च ॥३-६१-८॥
verses.transliteration: apūrayitvā tam kālam mat sakāśam iha āgataḥ ।kāma vṛttam anāryam mām mṛṣā vādinam eva ca ॥3-61-8॥

translations.english: My father say will surely in the other world: Without completing the appointed period of the vow taken, how could you come here ? Fie upon you You are irresponsible. You are ignoble. You are a liar.
translations.hindi: हे प्रिये ! मुझे यह मालूम हे कि, तू परिहास-म्रिय है, परन्तु बिशेष कर इस आश्रम-स्थान में परिहास करना अच्छा नहीं ।।७ आगच्छ त्वं विशालाक्षि शून्योञ्यमुटजस्तब सुव्यक्त राक्षसेः सीता भक्षिता वा हृताऽपि वा

verses.sloka: धिक् त्वाम् इति परे लोके व्यक्तम् वक्ष्यति मे पिता ।विवशम् शोक संतप्तम् दीनम् भग्न मनोरथम् ॥३-६१-९॥
verses.transliteration: dhik tvām iti pare loke vyaktam vakṣyati me pitā ।vivaśam śoka saṁtaptam dīnam bhagna manoratham ॥3-61-9॥

translations.english: O lovely lady where have you gone, leaving me here like fame deserting a crook? I am helpless griefstricken, pitiable, pathetic and disappointed. O lady of slender waist, leave me not. Separated from you, I will give up my life.

verses.sloka: माम् इह उत्सृज्य करुणम् कीर्तिः नरम् इव अन्ऋजुम् ।क्व गच्चसि वरारोहे मा मोत्सृज्य - मा मा उत्सृज्य - सुमध्यमे ॥३-६१-१०॥
verses.transliteration: mām iha utsṛjya karuṇam kīrtiḥ naram iva anṛjum ।kva gaccasi varārohe mā motsṛjya - mā mā utsṛjya - sumadhyame ॥3-61-10॥

translations.english: O lovely lady where have you gone, leaving me here like fame deserting a crook? I am helpless griefstricken, pitiable, pathetic and disappointed. O lady of slender waist, leave me not. Separated from you, I will give up my life.
translations.hindi: मानो कह रहे हैं कि, राक्तसों ने सीता को ख डाला है। दे मेरी पूज्ये ! हे पतित्रते ! बरवर्णि| पूज्ये ! हे पतिन्रते ! बरवर्णिनि ! तू कहाँ गयी ?

verses.sloka: त्वया विरहितः च अहम् त्यक्ष्ये जीवितम् आत्मनः ।इति इव विलपन् रामः सीता दर्शन लालसः ॥३-६१-११॥
verses.transliteration: tvayā virahitaḥ ca aham tyakṣye jīvitam ātmanaḥ ।iti iva vilapan rāmaḥ sītā darśana lālasaḥ ॥3-61-11॥

translations.english: Deeply distressed, Rama who was anxious to see Sita, daughter of Janaka, wailed and wailed but could not see her.

verses.sloka: न ददर्श सुदुःख आर्तो राघवो जनक आत्मजाम् ।अनासादयमानम् तम् सीताम् शोकपरायणम् ॥३-६१-१२॥
verses.transliteration: na dadarśa suduḥkha ārto rāghavo janaka ātmajām ।anāsādayamānam tam sītām śokaparāyaṇam ॥3-61-12॥

translations.english: Lakshmana, dedicated to his wellbeing, spoke to Rama, son of Dasaratha, who was sinking like an elephant into the quagmire, when he failed to trace Sita.

verses.sloka: पंकम् आसाद्य विपुलम् सीदन्तम् इव कुंजरम् ।लक्ष्मणो रामम् अत्यर्थम् उवाच हित काम्यया ॥३-६१-१३॥
verses.transliteration: paṁkam āsādya vipulam sīdantam iva kuṁjaram ।lakṣmaṇo rāmam atyartham uvāca hita kāmyayā ॥3-61-13॥

translations.english: Lakshmana, dedicated to his wellbeing, spoke to Rama, son of Dasaratha, who was sinking like an elephant into the quagmire, when he failed to trace Sita.
translations.hindi: सीता के इर जाने से मेरा कायरपन तो स्पष्ट ही है? मेर ए ही हे? में जब वनवास से लोट कर जाऊँगा, तब मिथिलेश जनक

verses.sloka: मा विषादम् महाबुद्धे कुरु यत्नम् मया सह ।इदम् गिरि वरम् वीर बहु कन्दर शोभितम् ॥३-६१-१४॥
verses.transliteration: mā viṣādam mahābuddhe kuru yatnam mayā saha ।idam giri varam vīra bahu kandara śobhitam ॥3-61-14॥

translations.english: O longarmed, heroic Rama, do not grieve. This forest is full of caves. Let us try together.
translations.hindi: प्ररण्यकाणडे अपनी चेटी जानकी के नाश से सन्तप्त हो मूच्छित हो जायँगे । अथवा में भरत द्वारा पालित अयोध्या में जाऊँ ही नहीं

verses.sloka: प्रिय कानन संचारा वन उन्मत्ता च मैथिली ।सा वनम् वा प्रविष्टा स्यात् नलिनीम् वा सुपुष्पिताम् ॥३-६१-१५॥
verses.transliteration: priya kānana saṁcārā vana unmattā ca maithilī ।sā vanam vā praviṣṭā syāt nalinīm vā supuṣpitām ॥3-61-15॥

translations.english: Sita is madly in love with the forest. She might have entered deep into the jungle or into a fully blossomed lotuspond.

verses.sloka: सरितम् वा अपि संप्राप्ता मीन वंजुल सेविताम् ।वित्रासयितु कामा वा लीना स्यात् कानने क्वचित् ॥३-६१-१६॥
verses.transliteration: saritam vā api saṁprāptā mīna vaṁjula sevitām ।vitrāsayitu kāmā vā līnā syāt kānane kvacit ॥3-61-16॥

translations.english: Maybe she has gone to take a dip in the river full of reeds and fishes Or has hidden somewhere for the sake of fun.

verses.sloka: जिज्ञासमाना वैदेही त्वाम् माम् च पुरुषर्षभ ।तस्या हि अन्वेषणे श्रीमन् क्षिप्रम् एव यतावहे ॥३-६१-१७॥
verses.transliteration: jijñāsamānā vaidehī tvām mām ca puruṣarṣabha ।tasyā hi anveṣaṇe śrīman kṣipram eva yatāvahe ॥3-61-17॥

translations.english: O best of men, maybe Vaidehi has hidden in the forest intending to scare you and me. She wishes to test our love. O blessed Rama let us ransack the forest immediately.

verses.sloka: वनम् सर्वम् विचिनुवो यत्र सा जनक आत्मजा ।मन्यसे यदि काकुत्स्थ मा स्म शोके मनः कृथाः ॥३-६१-१८॥
verses.transliteration: vanam sarvam vicinuvo yatra sā janaka ātmajā ।manyase yadi kākutstha mā sma śoke manaḥ kṛthāḥ ॥3-61-18॥

translations.english: O scion of the Kakutsthas, let us search all over the forest if you please. Do not indulge in sorrow.
translations.hindi: क्योंकि में सीता विना किसी प्रकार भी जीवित नहीं रह सकता । वहाँ जा ओर भरत को गाढ आलिंगन कर मेरी ओर से कहना ॥ १७ अचुज्ञातोऽसि रामेण पालयेति बसुन्धराम्‌ । अस्वा च भम केकेयी सुमित्रा च त्वया विभो

verses.sloka: एवम् उक्तः तु सौहार्दात् लक्ष्मणेन समाहितः ।सह सौमित्रिणा रामो विचेतुम् उपचक्रमे ॥३-६१-१९॥
verses.transliteration: evam uktaḥ tu sauhārdāt lakṣmaṇena samāhitaḥ ।saha saumitriṇā rāmo vicetum upacakrame ॥3-61-19॥

translations.english: When Lakshmana consoled him so affectionately Rama became composed. He continued the search with Lakshmana, son of Sumitra.

verses.sloka: तौ वनानि गिरीन् चैव सरितः च सरांसि च ।निखिलेन विचिन्वन्तौ सीताम् दशरथ आत्मजौ ॥३-६१-२०॥
verses.transliteration: tau vanāni girīn caiva saritaḥ ca sarāṁsi ca ।nikhilena vicinvantau sītām daśaratha ātmajau ॥3-61-20॥

translations.english: The two sons of Dasaratha went on searching for Sita in forests, mountains, rivers, ponds everywhere.

verses.sloka: तस्य शैलस्य सानूनि शिलाः च शिखराणि च ।निखिलेन विचिन्वन्तौ न एव ताम् अभिजग्मतुः ॥३-६१-२१॥
verses.transliteration: tasya śailasya sānūni śilāḥ ca śikharāṇi ca ।nikhilena vicinvantau na eva tām abhijagmatuḥ ॥3-61-21॥

translations.english: They were not able to find Sita even though they searched all over the mountain slopes, caves and peaks.
translations.hindi: भय और विकलता से लक्ष्मण जी भी व्यथित हो अत्यन्त आतुर हो गए

verses.sloka: विचित्य सर्वतः शैलम् रामो लक्ष्मणम् अब्रवीत् ।न इह पश्यामि सौमित्रे वैदेहीम् पर्वते शुभाम् ॥३-६१-२२॥
verses.transliteration: vicitya sarvataḥ śailam rāmo lakṣmaṇam abravīt ।na iha paśyāmi saumitre vaidehīm parvate śubhām ॥3-61-22॥

translations.english: After searching her all over, Rama said Saumitri, I am unable to find the noble Vaidehi on the mountain

verses.sloka: ततो दुःख अभिसंतप्तो लक्ष्मणो वाक्यम् अब्रवीत् ।विचरन् दण्डक अरण्यम् भ्रातरम् दीप्त तेजसम् ॥३-६१-२३॥
verses.transliteration: tato duḥkha abhisaṁtapto lakṣmaṇo vākyam abravīt ।vicaran daṇḍaka araṇyam bhrātaram dīpta tejasam ॥3-61-23॥

translations.english: Going about the Dandaka forest Lakshmana, consumed by sorrow, said to his brother, glowing with brilliance:

verses.sloka: प्राप्स्यसि त्वम् महाप्राज्ञ मैथिलीम् जनक आत्मजाम् ।यथा विष्णुः महाबाहुः बलिम् बद्ध्वा महीम् इमाम् ॥३-६१-२४॥
verses.transliteration: prāpsyasi tvam mahāprājña maithilīm janaka ātmajām ।yathā viṣṇuḥ mahābāhuḥ balim baddhvā mahīm imām ॥3-61-24॥

translations.english: O longarmed brother O wise sire just as Visnu obtained the earth by binding Bali you will obtain Sita certainly.

verses.sloka: एवम् उक्तः तु वीरेण लक्ष्मणेन स राघवः ।उवाच दीनया वाचा दुःख अभिहत चेतनः ॥३-६१-२५॥
verses.transliteration: evam uktaḥ tu vīreṇa lakṣmaṇena sa rāghavaḥ ।uvāca dīnayā vācā duḥkha abhihata cetanaḥ ॥3-61-25॥

translations.english: Having been addressed thus by Lakshmana, Raghava with a griefstriken heart said these piteous words :' Lakshmana,having spoken like that very affectionately to Rama,who was disturbed by excessive grief said these words piteously:

verses.sloka: वनम् सुविचितम् सर्वम् पद्मिन्यः फुल्ल पंकजाः ।गिरिः च अयम् महाप्राज्ञ बहु कन्दर निर्झरः ।न हि पश्यामि वैदेहीम् प्राणेभ्यो अपि गरीयसीम् ॥३-६१-२६॥
verses.transliteration: vanam suvicitam sarvam padminyaḥ phulla paṁkajāḥ ।giriḥ ca ayam mahāprājña bahu kandara nirjharaḥ ।na hi paśyāmi vaidehīm prāṇebhyo api garīyasīm ॥3-61-26॥

translations.english: O wise Lakshmana I have searched the entire forest, the ponds with fully blossomed lotuses, the mountains with many caves and streams. But could not see Vaidehi who is dearer to me than my life.

verses.sloka: एवम् स विलपन् रामः सीता हरण कर्शितः ।दीनः शोक समाविष्टो मुहूर्तम् विह्वलो अभवत् ॥३-६१-२७॥
verses.transliteration: evam sa vilapan rāmaḥ sītā haraṇa karśitaḥ ।dīnaḥ śoka samāviṣṭo muhūrtam vihvalo abhavat ॥3-61-27॥

translations.english: O wise Lakshmana I have searched the entire forest, the ponds with fully blossomed lotuses, the mountains with many caves and streams. But could not see Vaidehi who is dearer to me than my life.

verses.sloka: स विह्वलित सर्व अंगो गत बुद्धिः विचेतनः ।निषसाद आतुरो दीनो निःश्वस्य अशीतम् आयतम् ॥३-६१-२८॥
verses.transliteration: sa vihvalita sarva aṁgo gata buddhiḥ vicetanaḥ ।niṣasāda āturo dīno niḥśvasya aśītam āyatam ॥3-61-28॥

translations.english: Thus tormented by the abduction of Sita, Rama felt dejected and cried.Overpowered by grief he lost his consciousness for a moment.

verses.sloka: बहुशः स तु निःश्वस्य रामो राजीव लोचनः ।हा प्रिये ति विचुक्रोश बहुशो बाष्प गद्गदः ॥३-६१-२९॥
verses.transliteration: bahuśaḥ sa tu niḥśvasya rāmo rājīva locanaḥ ।hā priye ti vicukrośa bahuśo bāṣpa gadgadaḥ ॥3-61-29॥

translations.english: By grief tormented, limbs enervated, intellect atrophied, senses switched off, he felt anxious and depressed and sighed long and hot.

verses.sloka: तम् सान्त्वयामास ततो लक्ष्मणः प्रिय बान्धवम् ।बहु प्रकारम् शोक आर्तः प्रश्रितः प्रश्रित अंजलिः ॥३-६१-३०॥
verses.transliteration: tam sāntvayāmāsa tato lakṣmaṇaḥ priya bāndhavam ।bahu prakāram śoka ārtaḥ praśritaḥ praśrita aṁjaliḥ ॥3-61-30॥

translations.english: Rama, his throat choked, shed propuse tears, sighing, O my darling.

verses.sloka: अनादृत्य तु तत् वाक्यम् लक्ष्मण ओष्ठ पुट च्युतम् ।अपश्यन् ताम् प्रियाम् सीताम् प्राक्रोशत् स पुनः पुनः ॥३-६१-३१॥
verses.transliteration: anādṛtya tu tat vākyam lakṣmaṇa oṣṭha puṭa cyutam ।apaśyan tām priyām sītām prākrośat sa punaḥ punaḥ ॥3-61-31॥

translations.english: Then Lakshmana, the knower of dharma and a dear friend offered obeisance most humbly with folded palms and consoled Rama in many ways.
